title: WebDevJudge: Evaluating (M)LLMs as Critiques for Web Development Quality

layout.note: Three equal grey panels side by side under dark-navy header bars, joined by two labelled block arrows (Query-grounded at the top, Annotate near the bottom). The Judge panel is split into a tan Evaluator part and a grey Observation part in aligned rows, with Paradigm cards below.

lesson: Mirror the workflow with three dark-headed panels (collect, annotate, judge), join them with block arrows that carry the operation's name, carry one example through the first two panels, and put the formal symbols next to each heading so the figure doubles as the notation guide.
